An email containing a malicious URL was sent from `alyssat@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co` and was later removed after delivery.

info.submitted_answer:
The sender of the email messages that contained malicious URLs and were later removed after delivery is **Hailey Johnson** (email address: **alyssat@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co**). 

The email was sent to raphaelt@vnevado.alpineskihouse.co with the subject "Lee Don t miss 1969-Con Event next month" and contained a malicious URL (https://ms175052280.orangecliff-f53f26fd.eastus.azurecontainerapps.io/). It was initially delivered to the inbox but was subsequently moved to quarantine on 2024-07-17 at 10:50:35 UTC through Microsoft's Phish ZAP (Zero-hour Auto Purge) feature due to URL detonation reputation detection. This incident is part of a broader attack campaign that also included password spray attempts from IP address 170.54.121.63.
